title.zh: 先试一局的开场，不承诺整晚都负责
title.en: Try an opening without taking responsibility for the whole evening

paragraphs.zh: 新设一个原创桌游场景：朋友看不懂自编游戏的说明，你先画一张回合示例，只试能否解释第一步，不因此答应重写全部规则。开始前说好用十分钟，之后可以继续、换讲法或停下。若发现规则本身不清楚，记录问题也算得到信息。与曼恩相比，这里先产生一个可看的小版本；与琦薇相比，仍须承认哪些规则没有确认，不能用开始行动替代必要核对。反例是需要组织者许可的改动，此时先问比自行推进更合适。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original board-game scene: friends cannot follow a home-written rule sheet, so you draw one example turn to check whether the opening step is understandable, without promising to rewrite every rule. Agree on ten minutes, after which you can continue, explain differently or stop. Finding an unclear rule is information too. Compared with Maine, first make a small version visible; alongside Kiwi, acknowledge unconfirmed rules rather than using action to replace necessary checking. If a change needs the organiser’s permission, asking first can be the appropriate next step.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“这个第一版具体想弄清什么，哪些还没答应？”各自为同一个虚构爱好写一个十分钟版本，比较目的和停点，不比谁更敢冲。可以只读或画草稿，不做公开挑战、不花钱，也不把重做次数变成坚持力或勇气评分。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “What would this first version clarify, and what has not been promised?” Describe ten-minute versions of one invented hobby and compare purposes and stopping points rather than bravery. Reading or drafting is enough, without a public challenge, spending or converting repeated attempts into a determination score.

title.zh: 参加一个谜题，不等于同意所有新增安排
title.en: Joining a puzzle does not accept every later addition

paragraphs.zh: 新设原创场景：你答应参加二十分钟的猜谜活动，后来有人提议每周直播。可以说明愿意继续猜这一轮，但还没同意出镜或长期参与；不用交代不愿公开的私人原因。与法拉第相比，这里先保留自己想获得的体验，再谈新增条件；与曼恩相比，清楚的个人限度也能帮助集体安排。若原来就只约了二十分钟且得到尊重，没有必要为角色结果额外找一次拒绝来证明边界。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original scene: you agreed to twenty minutes of puzzle-solving, then someone suggests weekly livestreams. You can remain in this round without having accepted an appearance on camera or continuing participation, and need not supply private reasons. Compared with Faraday, first retain the experience you wanted before discussing new terms. Alongside Maine, a clear personal limit can help the group plan. If the original twenty-minute agreement is already respected, there is no need to manufacture another refusal to prove a character result.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“这句话说清了参加哪一部分，哪些仍待决定？”用编造邀请练一条实际回应，不解释个人过往、不要求朋友交代秘密，也不把安静或拒绝直播推成孤僻、信任差或某种依恋。愿意时把文字留给自己即可。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Which part does this response accept, and what remains undecided?” Draft a practical reply to an invented invitation without personal history or demands for secrets. Quietness or declining a livestream identifies neither isolation, poor trust nor attachment. The draft may stay private.

title.zh: 具体感谢可以安静，也要允许不被公开点名
title.en: Specific appreciation can be quiet and need not name someone publicly

paragraphs.zh: 新设原创场景：一位朋友为桌游夜带来缺少的计分纸，你想感谢，可以说“你带的纸让这一轮能继续，谢谢”。若准备发合照并点名，另问是否愿意公开，不把热情当成许可。与曼恩相比，先让当下的贡献被听见；与法尔科相比，感谢不能代替确认物品怎样归还。对方若只想安静参与，尊重这个请求也可以是回应，不证明关心更少。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original scene: a friend brings the missing score sheets for a game evening. You can thank them for enabling the next round. Publicly naming them in a group photograph needs a separate check; enthusiasm is not permission. Compared with Maine, first acknowledge a present contribution. Compared with Falco, appreciation does not replace agreeing how borrowed materials return. Respecting someone’s wish to participate quietly can also be a response, not evidence of less care.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“我们感谢的是哪件看见的事，有没有猜动机或替人宣布？”各写一句基于虚构贡献的感谢，允许不用热烈语气，也不用真的发送。不把角色结果当忠诚度、外向程度或善良证明，更不要求用冒险帮忙来符合人物。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Which observed action are we appreciating, and are we guessing motives or announcing something for them?” Write a sentence about an invented contribution, without needing exuberance or sending it. The result proves neither loyalty, extraversion nor kindness and requires no risky favour to fit a character.

title.zh: 把愿意参加和愿意承担的部分分开确认
title.en: Separate willingness to join from willingness to take a task

paragraphs.zh: 新设原创场景：四人答应参加自编故事之夜，却没人明确答应主持。你列出讲规则、计时和收材料三件事，再问谁愿意接哪项，允许先改成更简单的一轮。参加不自动等于同意承担任一工作；无人接的部分仍未约定。与大卫相比，这里先核人与安排怎样衔接；与法拉第相比，新增工作也需要被看见。若已有主持且分工清楚，做好自己原来的一项就足够，不必再接管。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original scene: four people agreed to a home-written story evening, but nobody agreed to host it. List explaining rules, keeping time and collecting materials, then ask who wants each task, with room to simplify the round. Joining is not automatic acceptance of a job; unclaimed work remains unagreed. Compared with David, first connect people with the arrangement. Alongside Faraday, make additional work visible. If a host and clear roles already exist, contributing your agreed part can be enough without taking over.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“谁已经答应了什么，谁只是被写进计划？”一起核一个虚构名单，分别标同意、待确认和不参加，不替真实朋友派任务。不用结果证明自己应领导，也不把更少的协调选择解释成不合群或缺少责任。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Who agreed to what, and who was merely written into the plan?” Mark agreed, unconfirmed and declined roles in an invented list without allocating real friends’ work. The result grants no leadership entitlement, and fewer coordination choices establish neither poor belonging nor irresponsibility.

title.zh: 版本号、来源与未知状态要一起留下
title.en: Retain version, source and unknown state together

paragraphs.zh: 新设原创场景：兴趣展的图片说明有旧稿写周六、新稿写周日，但新稿没有确认记录。你可以列出各自来源与更新时间，向负责日程的人询问；“较新”本身不自动等于获确认。确认前可告诉相关的人日期仍有冲突，不假装已经解决。与法拉第相比，先核事实与传递范围，不先替大家谈新增约定；与露西相比，不要求私人理由才能澄清日程。普通日期核对也无需搜他人账号或收集整段聊天。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original scene: an exhibition caption’s older draft says Saturday and a newer draft says Sunday, but the latter has no confirmation. Record sources and update times, then ask the person responsible for scheduling; newer does not automatically mean approved. Until clarified, tell affected people the dates conflict rather than presenting a resolution. Compared with Faraday, first check facts and recipients instead of negotiating new commitments. Unlike a question about personal purpose, this scheduling clarification needs no private reasons or searches through others’ accounts and chat histories.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“现在能确认哪一句，哪一句仍只是草稿？”用两条编造消息核对事实、推断和待询问对象，不测试朋友诚实、不把计数当识人能力。若未知已不影响下一步，也可保留未知；不必为角色结果不断多查。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Which statement is confirmed, and which remains a draft?” Compare two invented messages for facts, inferences and an appropriate source of clarification, without testing honesty or treating counts as an ability to read people. Leave an unknown open when it no longer changes the next action.

title.zh: 放到约定位置和已被接收不是同一状态
title.en: An agreed location and confirmed receipt are different states

paragraphs.zh: 新设原创场景：桌游夜后，你答应把借来的计分板放到社团柜中。可以记录“已放入指定柜，接收人尚未确认”，而不是写“对方已收妥”。若需要对方确认，应在约定范围内说明下一步；不因此长期替所有人保管材料。与琦薇相比，保留已知与未知；与曼恩相比，重点在这个具体交接，不重新组织全部人。没有明确接收地点时，可以先暂停并询问，不能靠多承担责任来消除信息缺口。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original scene: after game night, you agreed to put a borrowed scoring board in the club cupboard. Record placement at the agreed location with receipt still unconfirmed, rather than claiming the owner has received it. Clarify any needed acknowledgement within the agreement, without becoming everyone’s permanent custodian. Alongside Kiwi, retain known and unknown states; compared with Maine, focus on this handoff rather than reorganising the group. If no receiving location is agreed, pause and ask. Taking on more responsibility cannot fill missing information.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“东西在哪里、谁同意接、哪个状态还没确认？”各自写一条虚构交接备注，再让另一人只凭备注指出下一步。不实际运送物品，不承担他人安全，也不把更高次数当可靠性证书；备注可以在纸上结束。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Where is it, who agreed to receive it, and what remains unconfirmed?” Write an invented handoff note and let a partner identify the next step from that note alone. No transport or responsibility for anyone’s safety is required, and a higher count is no reliability certificate.

title.zh: 一次小稿与持续供稿需要分别同意
title.en: A one-off draft and continuing contributions need separate agreement

paragraphs.zh: 新设原创场景：你答应为社团画六个虚构图标草稿，后来提议变成每月持续画稿并回复修改。先列出新增频率、修改范围与可用时间，允许保留一次草稿、缩小尝试或拒绝后续，不把最初答应当成长期默认。与露西相比，先把双方约定具体化；与法尔科相比，结束一次任务不自动开始下一次。写清条件也不自动使安排公平，更不需要给普通友谊的一切都标价。
paragraphs.en: Use a fresh original scene: you agreed to draft six fictional icons for a club, then the proposal becomes monthly illustrations and revision replies. Identify frequency, revision scope and available time, allowing the original draft, a smaller trial or no continuing role. The first agreement does not silently become an ongoing one. Compared with Lucy, make mutual terms concrete; alongside Falco, ending one task does not start another. Explicit terms do not automatically make an arrangement fair or require pricing every ordinary friendship contribution.

title.zh: 比较一次具体选择，不把角色变成真人职责
title.en: Compare a particular choice without assigning people character duties

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“这次新增的是时间、次数还是责任，谁还没同意？”用编造请求写旧范围与新范围，不谈真实交易、不披露财务，也不试探朋友忠诚。可以发现无需交换就结束，不用角色结果解释谁自私、精明或适合谈判。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “Does the change add time, frequency or responsibility, and who has not agreed?” Compare old and proposed scopes in an invented request without a real deal, financial disclosure or loyalty test. Concluding that no exchange is needed is sufficient; the result identifies neither selfishness, shrewdness nor negotiating aptitude.
